_comment: Default scaffold for a new TIGER2 task's scripts/task_config.json. Written once by the quick-create channel (backend/services/task-dir.js scaffoldTaskConfig, called from POST /api/tasks/create) and never overwritten afterwards, so hand edits here are permanent. Fields marked FILL-IN are placeholders the quick-create channel cannot know and a human must set. See backend/tasktype/tiger2/lib/task_config.py for how every field is consumed, and docs/task-creation.md for the full workflow.
remoteDir: FILL-IN: absolute remote path where this task's NAMD run lives, e.g. /home/selp/igem-2026/MD/<name>
logPrefix: FILL-IN: NAMD log/config file prefix, e.g. tiger2_<name>

defaults.protein: FILL-IN: short protein/construct description shown on the Dashboard, e.g. '2KY10 SELP (339 aa)'

process.namdBin: FILL-IN (optional): NAMD build directory containing charmrun and namd3, e.g. ~/igem-2026/MD/NAMD_3.0.2_Linux-x86_64-netlrts-smp. Leave empty to discover the installed build.
